claim_text: The phase-sensitive average-success theorem holds with arbitrary ancillas.
assumptions: Uniform size-M subset; F-independent normalized input, unitaries, and phases; all F information enters through counted phase queries.
allowed_wording: Average success over uniform size-M marked sets is bounded by the phase-sensitive expression.
prohibited_wording: Every marked set obeys the bound pointwise.

claim_text: The reference marked-mass expectation equals M/N with arbitrary ancillas.
assumptions: Reference state is independent of F; uniform one-point inclusion marginals.
allowed_wording: The identity holds for arbitrary ancilla dimension.
prohibited_wording: The identity requires a uniform query state or no ancilla.

claim_text: The single-query perturbation norm equals c_t a_t.
assumptions: Phase-membership oracle exactly as defined.
allowed_wording: The perturbation equality is exact.
prohibited_wording: The same coefficient applies to a richer value oracle without reduction.

claim_text: The hybrid recursion yields d_q no greater than the weighted sum of reference marked amplitudes.
assumptions: d_t is indexed after query t and following V_t; equivalently before query t+1.
allowed_wording: With the explicit indexing convention the recursion holds.
prohibited_wording: The displayed subscripts are self-interpreting without defining when V_t is applied.

claim_text: Minkowski gives the L2 hybrid-distance bound.
assumptions: Finite second moments; pointwise hybrid inequality.
allowed_wording: The L2 norm is at most sqrt(phi) times the phase-coefficient sum.
prohibited_wording: Expectation can be moved through a norm without an inequality.

claim_text: The final projection and second Minkowski step prove the theorem.
assumptions: Orthogonal success projector; normalized states.
allowed_wording: The square-root success inequality holds pointwise and in L2.
prohibited_wording: Squaring is valid without checking signs.

claim_text: The coarse average bound is (2q+1)^2 phi, capped at one.
assumptions: Assumptions of T1.
allowed_wording: Average success is at most min{1,(2q+1)^2 phi}.
prohibited_wording: This is a pointwise upper bound.

claim_text: At least one feasible set has success at most the coarse bound.
assumptions: Uniform average over a nonempty finite family of size-M sets.
allowed_wording: There exists a hard size-M marked set.
prohibited_wording: Every size-M marked set is hard.

claim_text: A uniform worst-case target tau requires q at least one half of sqrt(tau/phi)-1.
assumptions: Fixed tau; phi>0; use max with zero and integer ceiling when needed.
allowed_wording: For phi tending to zero and fixed tau>0 the worst-case query cost is Omega(phi^-1/2).
prohibited_wording: A nontrivial lower bound holds unchanged when tau<=phi.

claim_text: Average success at least tau gives the same query lower bound.
assumptions: Uniform size-M average; phi>0; max with zero and integer ceiling when needed.
allowed_wording: Constant uniform-average success needs Omega(phi^-1/2) queries in the dilute limit.
prohibited_wording: The conclusion holds for an arbitrary nonuniform prior with no marginal correction.

claim_text: Polynomial queries and exponentially small phi imply exponentially small average success.
assumptions: alpha>0 fixed; q(n)<=C n^k eventually; n sufficiently large.
allowed_wording: For any beta<alpha the average success is eventually at most 2^{-beta n}.
prohibited_wording: The exponential envelope dominates every polynomial at all finite n.

claim_text: Fixed-schedule binary-feasibility QAOA has q=p and needs p=Omega(phi^-1/2) for constant worst-case success.
assumptions: One binary H_F cost query per layer; F-independent input, mixers, and phases; uniform guarantee over the full marked-set family.
allowed_wording: The depth result applies to the specified fixed binary-feasibility schedule.
prohibited_wording: p=q for every QAOA implementation.

claim_text: At most c relevant queries per layer gives p at least the query lower bound divided by c.
assumptions: q<=cp; c>0; same black-box assumptions.
allowed_wording: p>=max{0,(sqrt(tau/phi)-1)/(2c)}.
prohibited_wording: q<=cp alone supplies a query lower bound.

claim_text: Instance-trained QAOA is bounded through total query cost after deferred measurement and purification.
assumptions: Finite worst-case query cap; purified randomness; coherent outcomes; controlled feedback; padded branches; final projective success event.
allowed_wording: Training, shots, feedback, and final execution must all be counted.
prohibited_wording: The final trained circuit depth alone obeys the theorem automatically.

claim_text: Grover achieves sin^2((2q+1)arcsin sqrt(phi)) and matches q^2 phi at leading order.
assumptions: 0<M<N; standard pi membership oracle and uniform-state reflection; dilute regime for expansion.
allowed_wording: The construction establishes asymptotic order tightness.
prohibited_wording: The sine formula is proved here as a universal upper bound or exact optimality theorem.

claim_text: The direct theorem covers arbitrary marked subsets accessed only through phase membership queries.
assumptions: Direct theorem assumptions.
allowed_wording: This is a black-box marked-set theorem.
prohibited_wording: It covers extra uncounted access to F.

claim_text: A class containing every binary marked-set Hamiltonian inherits a worst-case global-QAOA lower bound.
assumptions: Uniform class guarantee and fixed instance-independent schedule.
allowed_wording: The binary family gives a worst-case corollary for such a class.
prohibited_wording: Every member of the larger class satisfies a pointwise upper bound.

claim_text: The theorem directly proves the same pointwise lower bound for natural structured RCSP Hamiltonians.
assumptions: Would require an unstructured marked-set embedding into RCSP or an RCSP-specific structural lower bound.
allowed_wording: Direct RCSP applicability is unproved.
prohibited_wording: All natural RCSP instances inherit the black-box bound.

claim_text: F-dependent initial feasible-superposition preparation remains covered.
assumptions: Violates F-independent initialization.
allowed_wording: Such preparation injects structure outside the direct model.
prohibited_wording: P=1 at q=0 refutes the theorem.

claim_text: F-dependent mixers remain covered.
assumptions: Violates F-independent inter-query unitaries.
allowed_wording: F-dependent mixers are an escape route whose construction cost must be counted.
prohibited_wording: Arbitrary mixers includes mixers compiled from F.

claim_text: A richer value oracle is directly covered by the membership-query theorem.
assumptions: Extra information must first be reduced to counted phase queries.
allowed_wording: A separate reduction or lower bound is required.
prohibited_wording: Any diagonal cost oracle is equivalent to one membership query.

claim_text: The original phi identity holds for every nonuniform prior.
assumptions: It holds only when one-point inclusion marginals are uniform; otherwise use mu_t.
allowed_wording: Use sqrt(mu_out)+sum c_t sqrt(mu_t) for a general prior.
prohibited_wording: Fixed cardinality alone forces E projection mass=M/N under every prior.
